command: pre-registration of plan W's read W1

metrics.context: E4 is running (its arrivals so far were seen); W0 (query selection by flow-loss gain) failed its gates; the threshold of 8 of 10 was fixed before any W1 episode

hypotheses.H1: per order, served arms > zero-shot (exact sign test; Holm over the two orders)
hypotheses.H2: per order, served arms NON-INFERIOR to E4's served arms on the same tasks and start states (task-level bootstrap 95% lower bound of the difference above -0.05)
hypotheses.H3: no damage, as E4's H2 (final against arrival-time compositions, non-inferiority -0.05)
hypotheses.primary: demonstrations requested per order, against E4's on the same order (counts)

metrics.written_before: any fit or episode of w1
